name: Gold (fear gauge)
summary: Gold near $3,633 on 24 Nov, 2.9% lower on the week and 22% lower over three months
state: Gold futures were near $3,633 early on 24 Nov, 2.9% lower on the week, 22% lower over three months and about 32% below the 52-week high (Yahoo Finance). The weekly fall is inside the 7% single-week Alert line, leaving the three-month fall of more than 8% in the Watch band. The decline has come as the dollar index reached its 52-week high (Yahoo Finance).
for_you: Holders of gold or gold funds have seen sharp falls since the summer. The price remains sensitive to the dollar and interest-rate expectations.
why: Gold is the oldest crisis hedge; disorderly surges signal fear about currencies, inflation or geopolitics.
drivers: Real interest rates, central-bank buying, geopolitical fear, dollar moves.

rubric.alert: 3-month gain > 20%, or a single-week move > 7% either way.
